question.latex: Let a line $L$ passing through the point $$1, 1, 1$$ be perpendicular to both the vectors $2\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}$ and $\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$. If $P$a, b, c$$ is the foot of perpendicular from the origin on the line $L$, then the value of $34$a + b + c$$ is :
question.unicode: Let a line L passing through the point 1, 1, 1 be perpendicular to both the vectors 2hat{i} + 2hat{j} + hat{k} and hat{i} + 2hat{j} + 2hat{k}. If Pa, b, c is the foot of perpendicular from the origin on the line L, then the value of 34a + b + c is :
question.plainText: Let a line L passing through the point 1, 1, 1 be perpendicular to both the vectors 2hat{i} + 2hat{j} + hat{k} and hat{i} + 2hat{j} + 2hat{k}. If Pa, b, c is the foot of perpendicular from the origin on the line L, then the value of 34a + b + c is :

explanation.latex:
The direction vector $\vec{d}$ of line $L$ is perpendicular to both given vectors, so we take their cross product:
$\vec{d} = (2\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}) \times (\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(4 - 2) - \hat{j}(4 - 1) + \hat{k}(4 - 2) = 2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$.
The equation of line $L$ is $\vec{r} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k} + \lambda(2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})$.
Thus, any point on $L$ is of the form $P(1 + 2\lambda, 1 - 3\lambda, 1 + 2\lambda)$.
If $P$ is the foot of the perpendicular from the origin, then the vector $\vec{OP}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{d}$.
$\vec{OP} \cdot \vec{d} = 0 \implies 2(1 + 2\lambda) - 3(1 - 3\lambda) + 2(1 + 2\lambda) = 0$.
$2 + 4\lambda - 3 + 9\lambda + 2 + 4\lambda = 0 \implies 17\lambda + 1 = 0 \implies \lambda = -\frac{1}{17}$.
Substitute $\lambda$ back to find the coordinates of $P(a, b, c)$:
$a = 1 + 2(-1/17) = 15/17$
$b = 1 - 3(-1/17) = 20/17$
$c = 1 + 2(-1/17) = 15/17$
Sum $a + b + c = \frac{15 + 20 + 15}{17} = \frac{50}{17}$.
Therefore, $34(a + b + c) = 34 \left(\frac{50}{17}\right) = 2 \times 50 = 100$.

The equation of line L is vec{r} = hat{i} + hat{j} + hat{k} + lambda(2hat{i} - 3hat{j} + 2hat{k}).
Thus, any point on L is of the form P(1 + 2lambda, 1 - 3lambda, 1 + 2lambda).
If P is the foot of the perpendicular from the origin, then the vector vec{OP} is perpendicular to vec{d}.
vec{OP} · vec{d} = 0 implies 2(1 + 2lambda) - 3(1 - 3lambda) + 2(1 + 2lambda) = 0.
2 + 4lambda - 3 + 9lambda + 2 + 4lambda = 0 implies 17lambda + 1 = 0 implies lambda = -(1/17).
Substitute lambda back to find the coordinates of P(a, b, c):
a = 1 + 2(-1/17) = 15/17
b = 1 - 3(-1/17) = 20/17
c = 1 + 2(-1/17) = 15/17
Sum a + b + c = (15 + 20 + 15/17) = (50/17).
Therefore, 34(a + b + c) = 34 left((50/17)right) = 2 × 50 = 100.
